from autorouter import pipeline as p,floor_route as f,sexpr as sx,local_settings as ls
from experiments.fanout_baseline_v1 import pair as c,continuation as owned
from experiments.native_paired_v1 import observations as obs
READER_WHOLE_UPPER=90.
CURRENT_HEAD='02ce10890b92b9161756886b58a5aac7d8f2e118'


def require(value,message):
    if not value:raise p.Rejected(message)


def pure_git_gate():
    """Only existing read-only Git identity calls; not OS isolation."""
    old_run,old_popen=subprocess.run,subprocess.Popen
    prefix=['git','-c','core.fsmonitor=false','-c','core.hooksPath=/dev/null']
    allowed=[['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],[*prefix,'rev-parse','HEAD'],[*prefix,'status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=normal']]
    def check(argv,kwargs):
        require(type(argv)is list and argv in allowed and Path(kwargs.get('cwd','')).resolve()==ROOT
                and not kwargs.get('shell') and kwargs.get('executable') is None,'pure reader refuses subprocess')
    def popen(argv,*args,**kwargs):check(argv,kwargs);return old_popen(argv,*args,**kwargs)
    def run(argv,*args,**kwargs):check(argv,kwargs);return old_run(argv,*args,**kwargs)
    subprocess.run,subprocess.Popen=run,popen
    return old_run,old_popen


def read(head,pin,output):
    require(head==CURRENT_HEAD,'exact verified new002/pair/reader HEAD required')
    output=ls.canonical(output)
    require(ROOT/'.runs' in output.parents,'fresh root runner-owned .runs output required')
    witness={};materials={};routes=[]
    def remember(path):
        path=ls.canonical(Path(path));value=p.sha(path)
        if str(path) in witness:require(witness[str(path)]==value,'previously read input changed')
        witness[str(path)]=value;return value
    def material(path):
        value=c.shared.material(path);key=str(path)
        if key in materials:require(materials[key]==value,'completed material changed')
        materials[key]=value;return value
    labels=dict(native_prepare='native-prepare',native_run='native-run',pair_prepare='pair-prepare',stock45='ir-stock45',NONE='ir-NONE')
    plan=f.read_json(c.PROTOCOL);require(remember(c.PROTOCOL)==pin and plan['git_head']==head,'exact frozen pair HEAD/protocol required');c.context(plan,pin)
    native=f.read_json(owned.PROTOCOL);npin=remember(owned.PROTOCOL)
    require(native['git_head']==head and native['tools']==plan['tools'],'owned/pair/current HEAD and tools must be identical')
    def command_cost(key,module,mode,protocol=None,angle=None,required=True):
        path=ROOT/'.runs/fanout-command-receipts-004'/labels[key]/'execution.json'
        if not path.is_file():
            require(not required,'complete process-exit cost missing: '+key);return None
        receipt_pin=remember(path)
        record=f.read_json(path);process=record['process']
        require(record.get('label')==labels[key] and record.get('controller_sha256')==remember(ROOT/'.runs/run-fanout-command-004.py') and record.get('module_sha256')==remember(Path(module)),'command producer/module source binding differs')
        argv=[str(ROOT/'.venv/bin/python'),'-B',str(Path(module).resolve()),'--mode',mode,'--source-head',head]
        if protocol is not None:argv+=['--protocol-sha256',protocol]
        if angle is not None:argv+=['--project','ir-obstacle','--arm',angle]
        if key=='pair_prepare':argv+=['--control-sha256',plan['control_sha256']]
        # A root wrapper may apply the existing deny-network prefix. Neither
        # inner --mode worker nor a different order/command is a timing source.
        require(process.get('argv') in (argv,[*f.SANDBOX,*argv]),'cost must observe exact complete controller command: '+key)
        require(record.get('source_git_head')==head and process.get('cleanup_complete') is True,'complete cost HEAD/cleanup differs')
        require(process.get('cwd')==str(path.parent),'complete command must run in its bounded owned envelope cwd')
        values=[process.get(k) for k in ('wall_seconds','cpu_seconds','monitor_cpu_seconds')]
        require(all(c.q.finite_nonnegative(x) for x in values),'actual complete process costs unavailable')
        require(process.get('log_truncated') is False,'complete command log truncated')
        require(process.get('log')==str(path.parent/'command.log') and type(process.get('log_bytes'))is int and 0<=process['log_bytes']<=256*1024,'bounded owned command log differs')
        guards=process.get('resource_guards',{});require(guards.get('max_workdir_bytes')==8*1024**2 and guards.get('max_group_rss_bytes')==4*1024**3,'fixed command envelope caps differ')
        log=ls.canonical(Path(process['log']));require(remember(log)==record.get('log_sha256'),'complete command log pin differs')
        require(process.get('resource_accounting',{}).get('method')=='wait4 child rusage','complete exited-process rusage required')
        time_label='native-prepare002' if key=='native_prepare' else labels[key]
        timing=ROOT/'.runs/fanout-missing-command-timing-001'/(time_label+'-time.log');remember(timing)
        text=c.io.read_bytes(timing,4096).decode();pairs=re.findall(r'^(real|user|sys) ([0-9.]+)$',text,re.M)
        require(len(pairs)==3 and {k for k,v in pairs}=={'real','user','sys'},'complete external wrapper timing missing/duplicate')
        t={k:float(v) for k,v in pairs};require(all(c.q.finite_nonnegative(v) for v in t.values()),'external timing malformed')
        remember(ROOT/'.runs/fanout-missing-command-timing-001'/(time_label+'-command.log'))
        wall=t['real']+.01;full=t['user']+t['sys']+.02
        require(wall>=values[0] and full>=sum(values[1:]),'external whole wrapper cost cannot omit exited controller work')
        return dict(wall_seconds=wall,full_cpu_seconds=full,process_exit_wall_seconds=values[0],process_exit_cpu_plus_monitor=sum(values[1:]),external_time=t,rounding_wall_upper_seconds=.01,rounding_cpu_upper_seconds=.02,process_status=process['status'],exit_code=process.get('exit_code'),receipt=str(path),receipt_sha256=receipt_pin)
    native_prepare=command_cost('native_prepare',owned.__file__,'prepare');native_run=command_cost('native_run',owned.__file__,'run',npin)
    # Continuation already binds and charges all fixed prior attempts once.
    owned.check_prior_witness();prior_attempts=native['prior_attempts']
    # Specific refused003 malformed-HEAD preparation, not a general old-HEAD exception.
    refused_path=ROOT/'.runs/fanout-command-receipts-003/native-prepare/execution.json';remember(refused_path);refused=f.read_json(refused_path);rp=refused['process']
    bad_head='02ce1089a000000000000000000000000000000000'
    require(refused.get('source_git_head')==bad_head and rp.get('argv')==[str(ROOT/'.venv/bin/python'),'-B',str(Path(owned.__file__)),'--mode','prepare','--source-head',bad_head]
        and rp.get('status')=='nonzero_exit' and type(rp.get('exit_code'))is int and rp['exit_code']!=0 and rp.get('cleanup_complete') is True,'specific refused003 preparation changed')
    require(refused.get('controller_sha256')==remember(ROOT/'.runs/run-fanout-command-003.py') and refused.get('module_sha256')==remember(Path(owned.__file__)),'refused003 source binding changed')
    require(remember(Path(rp['log']))==refused['log_sha256'],'refused003 command log changed')
    refused_time=ROOT/'.runs/fanout-missing-command-timing-001/native-prepare-time.log';remember(refused_time)
    matches=re.findall(r'^(real|user|sys) ([0-9.]+)$',c.io.read_bytes(refused_time,4096).decode(),re.M);require(len(matches)==3 and {k for k,v in matches}=={'real','user','sys'},'refused003 complete timing missing')
    rt={k:float(v) for k,v in matches};require(rt=={'real':.51,'user':.26,'sys':.04},'fixed refused003 costs changed')
    remember(ROOT/'.runs/fanout-missing-command-timing-001/native-prepare-command.log')
    refused_preparation=dict(process_receipt=str(refused_path),source_head=bad_head,native_executed=False,wall_seconds=rt['real']+.01,full_cpu_seconds=rt['user']+rt['sys']+.02,scope='Specific root typo refusal before protocol/Native, separately retained and charged once outside frozen internal prior3.')
    pair_prepare=command_cost('pair_prepare',c.__file__,'prepare')
    for label,value in [('native_prepare',native_prepare),('native_run',native_run),('pair_prepare',pair_prepare)]:
        require(value['process_status']=='success' and type(value['exit_code'])is int and value['exit_code']==0,'required complete command failed: '+label)
    native_complete_wall=prior_attempts['wall_seconds']+refused_preparation['wall_seconds']+native_prepare['wall_seconds']+native_run['wall_seconds']
    native_complete_cpu=prior_attempts['full_cpu_seconds']+refused_preparation['full_cpu_seconds']+native_prepare['full_cpu_seconds']+native_run['full_cpu_seconds']
    native_complete_within180=all(c.q.finite_nonnegative(v) and v<=180 for v in (native_complete_wall,native_complete_cpu))
    qualified,binding=c.control(plan['control_sha256'],Path(plan['control_receipt']))
    require(binding==plan['control_binding'],'owned control full binding changed')
    material(owned.OUT);remember(owned.OUT/'result.json');remember(owned.CHILD/'result.json')
    material(owned.POSITIVE);material(owned.OLD_OUTER.parent);remember(owned.POSITIVE/'route/result.json');remember(owned.OLD_OUTER);remember(owned.OLD_PROTOCOL)
    rows=[]
    dispositions=c.dispositions(plan,pin)
    for project,angle in c.ORDER:
        outerpath=c.OUT/project/angle/'result.json';folder=outerpath.parent;cfg=plan['projects'][project];board=Path(cfg['source']);original=sx.read(board)
        cost=command_cost(angle,c.__file__,'run',pin,angle,required=False)
        if not outerpath.is_file():
            disposition=next(r for r in dispositions['rows'] if r['project']==project and r['angle']==angle)
            rows.append(dict(project=project,angle=angle,passed=False,disposition=disposition,complete_command=cost,candidate=None));continue
        outer=f.read_json(outerpath);remember(outerpath);require(material(folder)==outer.get('completed_evidence'),'outer completed material differs')
        require(outer.get('protocol_sha256')==pin and outer.get('git_head')==head,'arm outer protocol/HEAD differs')
        process=outer.get('process',{});expected=[*f.SANDBOX,str(ROOT/'.venv/bin/python'),'-B',str(Path(c.__file__)), '--mode','worker','--source-head',head,'--protocol-sha256',pin,'--project',project,'--arm',angle]
        require(process.get('argv')==expected and process.get('cwd')==str(folder) and process.get('log')==str(folder/'command.log'),'arm actual worker process binding differs')
        remember(folder/'command.log')

        childpath=folder/'child/result.json'

        require(outer.get('child_receipt_sha256')==childpin and f.canonical(outer.get('child'))==f.canonical(child),'outer child pin/literal differs')

        data=f.read_json(receipt);remember(receipt);routes.append((route,data))

            settings=c.fanout_record(route,data) if (route/'engine-process.json').is_file() else None
